design.outputs: 384px per-image JPG, native pattern crop, contact sheets, CSV, scalar logs; saved and zipped after each image
design.external_baseline: Not included; R71 ETA03 is an internal baseline, not an external method.

preregistration.primary: Joint success: requested edit achieved AND correct subject/count AND specific source pattern retained AND no major artifact. Missing ratings stay pending. Report all 60 generation outcomes; do not drop failures.
preregistration.comparison: Compare per task/seed to embedded R71 CORR_KV and ETA03. Rank by joint success, then pattern quality among common successful pairs; report both denominators. Keep per-task results, not only pooled NCC.
preregistration.time: C50, C_EARLY, C_LATE have equal sum(h_i*lambda_i)=0.5*sum(h_i). Same KV schedule. G_FADE and G_MATCH have equal sum(h_i*gate_i) within first 7 steps. G50 is a separate half-strength control.
preregistration.decision: Select one shared configuration using all four decision tasks. Require improved joint successes vs CORR_KV with no loss on the rug success case and fewer severe cup/dog artifacts. If no new arm improves this balance, retain CORR_KV as task-dependent trade-off; report the failed timing hypothesis. dog_snow is a transfer diagnostic for three predefined arms, not adaptive post-selection.
preregistration.status: Development experiments on existing source objects. Final publication table still needs independent-object evaluation and an actual external method.
preregistration.cost: Report standalone cost as standalone_inversion_nfe+nfe_edit, plus actually charged/cache-amortized NFE separately. No zero-extra-forward claim.
